biology: Host recorded as the rubber tree.
soldier: Head brown tinged with red, thoracic and abdominal tergites dark brown. Head nearly rectangular, length about 1.25 to 1.36 times the width, the posterior margin nearly straight; fontanelle at the midpoint, in lateral view the dorsal margin and the postmentum both slightly arched; labrum lanceolate, the semi-transparent area at the tip triangular; mandibles short and stout, the apex slightly curved, the fine teeth at the middle of the inner margin of the left mandible indistinct, with two incisions near the mandibular base; antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 about 1.5 times segment 2; compound eyes dot-like; postmentum about more than four times as long as the narrowest part, the waist region in front of the midpoint, the sides gradually widening backwards from the middle. The anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum both incised in the middle, the lateral lobes broadly rounded; mesonotum and metanotum wider than or almost equal to the pronotum, their lateral lobes distinctly projecting at an angle.
